name: mi-fitness-api
// image: The dependency-heavy `builder` stage that CI publishes on every vcpkg.json / Dockerfile change (.github/workflows/builder-cache.yml). It already contains gcc-13, cmake, ninja, the /opt/vcpkg toolchain AND the full prebuilt vcpkg world at /app/build/vcpkg_installed — so the first configure here is seconds, not the ~30-minute cold dependency build. The upstream package is public; if your fork keeps its GHCR package private, `docker login ghcr.io` (PAT with read:packages) before opening the container. Forks: point this at your own GHCR namespace after `make init` (the upstream image still works until your first builder-cache CI run). Note: the image is linux/amd64 only — on Apple Silicon it runs under emulation (slow compiles); prefer an x86_64 host or codespace.
// workspaceFolder: Deliberately NOT /app: the image keeps its own /app (sources + build + the prebuilt /app/build/vcpkg_installed). Mounting the checkout over /app would hide that tree and force the cold vcpkg build the image exists to avoid.
// mounts: build/ on a named volume: native-FS speed for object files on macOS/Windows hosts, and incremental state survives container rebuilds.
// containerEnv: PRESET=devcontainer flips every Makefile local target (test-local, build-local, compile-commands, ...) to the `devcontainer` CMake preset, whose VCPKG_INSTALLED_DIR cache variable points the vcpkg toolchain at the world already installed inside the image — the configure-time manifest install becomes a no-op instead of a from-source rebuild. (A cache variable, not an env var: the pinned vcpkg's toolchain only honors -DVCPKG_INSTALLED_DIR.) Editing vcpkg.json later rebuilds only the delta.
// features: docker-in-docker gives the compose targets (make up / make test) a real daemon inside the container — run `make warm-cache` there first so `make test` reuses the CI layers. The day-to-day inner loop stays native: make test-local NAME='Foo*'.
// postCreateCommand: Configure (the `devcontainer` preset, via PRESET above) + symlink compile_commands.json for clangd. Seconds, not a build: the vcpkg install step no-ops against the prebaked /app/build/vcpkg_installed.
